Dear BEREX Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Content Creator position at BEREX, as advertised. With a strong background in digital marketing, SEO, and website content management, I am confident in my ability to contribute to strengthening your brand and digital presence.

My experience includes crafting engaging SEO-focused content, managing website content, and utilizing tools like WordPress and Canva to create effective digital assets. I am skilled in ensuring brand consistency and have a proven track record of supporting teams in developing and optimizing digital channels for clients. My fluent English and working knowledge of Dutch would also be valuable in the Brussels context.

I am eager to apply my blend of content creation and technical skills to support BEREX’s continued growth. My CV, attached for your review, provides further detail on my qualifications.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

cover_letter:
Dear BEREX Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Content Creator position at BEREX. My background in digital marketing, coupled with a focus on SEO, content, and web development, aligns closely with your needs for strengthening BEREX’s brand and digital presence.

My experience at Episto and Knowledge Experts has provided me with a robust foundation in crafting and managing diverse digital content. I have a proven track record in SEO blog and website content writing, developing keyword-targeted articles, and overseeing content management systems for client websites. This includes publishing and updating pages, blog posts, and media in WordPress, ensuring a consistent and professional online identity, as demonstrated by maintaining a uniform layout for numerous member profile pages on majistralecza.epis.to. I am also adept at tracking content performance using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, ensuring content is not only engaging but also measurably effective.

Beyond written content, I am proficient in using Canva for visual content creation and possess experience in designing and building entire websites, from structure to content integration across various digital channels, including social media. My collaborative nature is evident in my contributions to team projects, supporting the development of significant digital workplace sites and client web presences. With fluent English and a working knowledge of Dutch, I am well-prepared to contribute effectively in Brussels’ multicultural environment.

BEREX's commitment to combining real estate expertise with modern digital tools resonates deeply with my own approach to marketing. My technical background, including AI-powered search optimization and automation skills, allows for a forward-thinking perspective on content creation and efficiency. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to bring my blend of creative and technical capabilities to your team, helping to produce clear, efficient, and accessible content that reflects BEREX’s high standards.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can benefit BEREX.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
- Developed and managed SEO blog and website content for diverse client sites, including consulting and e-commerce platforms, tracking performance with analytics tools.
- Skilled in comprehensive CMS content management using WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) for publishing, updating, and maintaining consistent site layouts.
- Proficient in Canva for creating compelling visuals and experienced in integrating content across digital channels, including social media.
- Contributed to building and optimizing client websites, handling content strategy, structure, and ensuring a professional digital presence.
- Fluent in English with working knowledge of Dutch, and experience collaborating effectively within marketing teams on client-focused projects.
